item.title: 347-Powered 1976 Ford Bronco Sport
item.description: This 1976 Ford Bronco Sport is said to have spent most of its life in California before being relocated to Nevada in 2021, and it was acquired by the current owner on BaT in January 2022. Later that year, the engine was bored and stroked to a displacement of 347ci and reassembled with Edelbrock cylinder heads, a SCAT Crankshafts crankshaft and pistons, Edelbrock Pro-Flo 4 fuel injection, MSD ignition components, and more. item.title: 1985 Toyota Celica Supra 5-Speed
item.description: This 1985 Toyota Celica Supra P-Type is a Canadian-market car that was acquired by the seller in 2017 and was refurbished under current ownership. item.title: 2,100-Mile 2021 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500KR Widebody
item.description: This 2021 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500KR coupe was sold new from Pierre Ford in Seattle, Washington, and remained registered to its original owner until November 2025, during which time the car underwent GT500KR and widebody conversions. item.title: 5,800-Mile 2001 Lamborghini Diablo VT 6.0
item.description: This 2001 Lamborghini Diablo VT 6.0 is said to have been acquired new by the former owner of the Washington Redskins and later spent over 20 years in California before being acquired by the selling dealer in 2025. Finished in Grigio Antares over black leather, the car is powered by a 6.0-liter V12 linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a Viscous Traction all-wheel-drive system with front and rear limited-slip differentials. item.title: Original-Owner 1969 Jaguar XKE Series II Coupe
item.description: This 1969 Jaguar XKE Series II coupe was purchased new by the owner. It is powered by a 4.2-liter inline-six linked with a four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. Finished in silver over black leather, the car is equipped with a louvered clamshell hood, four-wheel disc brakes, 15" wire wheels, a heater, and an AM/FM radio. This XKE coupe is now offered by the seller on behalf of the owner with service records and a clean California title in the owner's name.

item.title: Euro 1993 Ferrari 512 TR
item.description: This 1993 Ferrari 512 TR is a European-market example that was first sold through Symbol Automobile S.A. in Matran, Switzerland, and was imported to the US in 2002.
